actions.script_source:
import pandas as pd
pheno = pd.read_csv('analysis/integrated_analysis/phase1_phenotype/strain_phenotype_table.csv')
meta = pd.read_csv('analysis/linked_data/sample_metadata.csv.gz')
ms_strains = set(meta['canonical_strain'])
pheno_ms = pheno[pheno['strain_id'].isin(ms_strains)]
counts = pheno_ms.groupby('species').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(counts.to_string())
